name: Festival bonus for an RMG worker, grade G4 at Tk 13,025, with exactly one year of service on the cut-off
source: hand-worked from the BD pack rules
working: Service from 1 Mar 2026 to the cut-off 1 Mar 2027 = 12 completed months (a month completes on the same day of the month); 12 ≥ 12, so the bonus is due (Labour Rules 2015, rule 111)
Pay in force on the cut-off: Tk 13025 on RMG_WORKER (from 1 Mar 2026); BASIC = round((13025 − 2450) ÷ 1.5) = round(7050) = 7050
Grade G4 minimum is gross 13025 and basic 7050: met
